blocked_items.name: Ellipsis still visible/legible after text-neutral-400 was dropped
blocked_items.reason: Ellipsis only renders at >=10 pages (deployed bundle short-circuits: if (pages <= 9) return [1..pages]). Max reachable across every probed surface was 5. Not hand-injected, per constraint.
blocked_items.residual_risk: Static analysis of the deployed bundle: the ellipsis renders as a <span> with no type attribute, and the only base colour rule is [type=button]-scoped, so its colour now comes by inheritance rather than from a token. Falsifiable in one measurement on a >=10-page surface.
